sourceAuthority: Public SVHL reciprocal games and standings; exact public player ID roster facts

policy.strengthBasis: Results-only margin-adjusted Elo within source-connected league-night component; optional verified recent settled game updates
policy.sideSignals: Current roster scoring concentration, exact cross-night player ID observations, previous winter roster samples, and exact archived Sunday player-ID division experience. Other nights use historical roster aggregates only.
policy.crossNightCalibration: All current exact player links are analyzed but numeric cross-night strength transfer is HELD until league-assigned comparable division tiers and validation exist
policy.reasonForZeroWeights: Source model prospective validation did not demonstrate meaningful independent improvement over results-only; do not invent calibrated player impact
policy.tierAssignments: League must assign effective-dated, program-scoped strength levels to each division through authorized governance; public draft picker cannot authorize them
policy.currentModelComponents: Same-night, same-program and source-connected component only; no Masters/Open/Separate program mixing
policy.uncertainty: Estimated matchup parity is an internal pairwise model proxy, not a calibrated future win probability
policy.outcomeEligibility: Only final reciprocal source-qualified fixtures affect the numeric rating; 0-0 holds and future games never count as settled
policy.groupSizePolicy: Evaluate 4–10 team groups, allow size and division-count changes of at most one per source-connected pool, penalize odd/small/oversized groups and avoid nonmaterial changes
policy.operationsHold: Facility capacity, number of available ice sheets, season scheduling rules, cross-division playoff format and commissioner approval are not connected

bridgeEvidence.sourceIdentityBasis: Exact public SVHL playerID across nights only, not player name
